gr_presenter.text: Ciúnas! Quiet! Oh, we're off air. Grand. Raidió na Gaeltachta, broadcasting in Irish since 1972. We play everything: sean-nós singing, trad, pop in Irish, and the death notices.
The death notices are very popular. Everybody listens, just to be sure.

gr_producer.text: Sean-nós means 'old style'. Unaccompanied singing, ornamented, every singer does each verse differently. You don't perform it at people. You sort of hand it to them.
